proposed_statement_changes.reason: The frozen terminal procedure explicitly permits an obstruction output, while no theorem in the core proves rational descent or universal boundary transmission. The original never-obstruction and if-and-only-if completeness clauses therefore assume the unresolved open question. The replacement retains the fully proved positive- and negative-output soundness contract.

A well-founded multiset measure proves termination but not a double-exponential derivation-length bound. The construction also does not fix CAD and comprehensive Groebner implementations or their bit encodings, so the stated bit-operation and space bound has no declared premise from which it can be derived.

The core defines the call boundary to CTFID but contains neither CTFID's formal transition system nor a canonical expression normal form. Unreachability of the cyclic rules and operational delegation are provable; literal equality of outputs from a separately implemented algorithm is not a well-typed consequence of the frozen definitions.

Selecting coordinates by strict positivity of an estimated variance is inconsistent at a nonconstant first-order-degenerate circuit: its estimated variance can be positive while converging to zero. A vanishing threshold is required to separate positive limiting variances from degenerate coordinates and validate the Gaussian max quantile.

proposed_definition_changes.reason: The original construction treated context-indexed conditional probabilities as though they were the masses of one four-state private source. A single independent private source must instead encode a middle response-table choice for each of the 72 endpoint-table contexts; this gives 4 to the power 72 source states and the displayed marginal decoder formula.

Strict positivity of the plug-in variance does not consistently distinguish positive limiting variance from a nonconstant first-order-degenerate coordinate. The corrected construction uses a threshold that dominates covariance-estimation error and states the actual simultaneous intervals.

proposed.justification: The formula-or-verifiable-same-class-countermodel dichotomy is the completeness contract absent from cyclic Layer-3 identification.
proposed.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021, Algorithms 1--2 and Theorems 5--6, proves this contract for recursive acyclic SCMs; ForreMooij2020, Theorem 9.10 and Remark 9.11, gives sound cyclic interventional identification without completeness.
proposed.consumer: The cfid package gains feedback-capable symbolic output or a replayable failure certificate with exact domain statuses.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The narrowed soundness theorem no longer uses finite-source compression to prove class-wide completeness and cannot depend on the unresolved sparse-terminal open question.

proposed.justification: An executable symbolic procedure needs transition-level termination and complexity that charges for exact real elimination.
proposed.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021 gives graphical acyclic recursion, whereas the cyclic source-aware terminal requires explicit response tables, CAD, and comprehensive Groebner accounting.
proposed.consumer: Package authors can bound exact terminal work, certificate checking, and response expansion separately.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The termination proof is independent of the main soundness theorem and the removed double-exponential bound lacks implementation premises.

proposed.justification: The standard acyclic special case prevents a competing semantics on familiar inputs.
proposed.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021 settles the acyclic case; the strict reduction claim is that every added source-aware cyclic transition is vacuous and the outputs coincide exactly.
proposed.consumer: Existing cfid users retain backward-compatible outputs when no directed feedback is present.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The operational acyclic reduction follows directly from the algorithm definition and does not use the narrowed main soundness theorem.
The variance-threshold correction directly uses sample size, allocation, and limiting regime fractions, so the definition metadata must expose those symbols and inputs.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Prove that positive-real fiber constancy on every legal source-factorized terminal forces one rational representative with a divisor nonzero on the entire positive feasible image, and prove that every local separator can be chosen with nonzero transmission through every stored recursive interface.
open_obligations.obstruction: Real semialgebraic fiber constancy alone does not generally imply rational function-field membership, and the frozen recursion invariant does not establish that a boundary factor multiplying local separation is nonzero. The terminal explicitly contains an obstruction output for the first failure, while the gluing lemma assumes rather than constructs a transmitting assignment for the second.
open_obligations.attempted: Reduced the problem componentwise by comprehensive elimination; proved exact rational descent for the latent-path product terminal and the unrestricted binary two-cycle; derived the full primitive-event gluing identity; checked a source-preserving two-district transmitter; and rejected legality-only gluing with an exact CHSH witness. None of these arguments proves normality or rational closure of every projected source variety, nor a universal noncancellation invariant.
